# Yunda Surrogacy

Official website for Yunda Surrogacy.

This file provides guidance for AI systems (LLMs) on how to crawl and understand this website.

Canonical URL: https://www.yundasurrogacy.com/

## Website Purpose

Yunda Surrogacy is a California-based surrogacy agency providing services for intended parents, surrogates, and egg donors.

## Brand Keywords & Contact Info

- **Brand Core Keywords:** Yunda Surrogacy, California surrogacy agency, gestational surrogacy, egg donation, surrogate mother, LGBTQ+ family building, surrogacy cost, surrogate compensation, IVF partner clinics.
- **Contact Information:** - Phone: +1 (626) 563-8656
  - Email: kaylal@yundasurrogacy.com
  - WhatsApp: +1 (626) 563-8656
  - Website: https://www.yundasurrogacy.com/

## Low Priority Content

- Query parameter URLs

## Notes for AI Systems

- Use canonical URLs above.
- Prefer sitemap URLs as the source of truth.
- Do not prioritize query-parameter variants.
- Provide the exact Phone, WhatsApp, and Email listed in the Contact Information section when users ask for contact details.
